activities.passageTitle: Grow a Bean in a Cup
passage: How to grow a bean in a cup:
First, fill a cup with soil.
Next, push a bean seed into the soil.
Then, water it a little every day.
Last, put the cup in a sunny window and watch it sprout.

items.text: Push the seed into the soil.

vocabulary: brote: una planta nueva y pequeña
activities.correct: The steps go: plant the seed, water it, then watch it sprout.
